shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; grep -ril calendar node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; ls __agent_eval__; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20
npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; cat $d/package.json | grep -A15 '"exports"'; ls $d/dist/esm/components; cat $d/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; cat $d/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls $d/docs; grep -rn "settings\|locale" $d/README.md | head -20
